title: No-source source discovery pilot design

no_source_assumption.rationale: The user/ChatGPT decision treats the current iCloud-derived library as no-source. The next useful stage is reverse-search/source-discovery pilot design, not exact-source inventory.

provider_research.source_entity_usefulness: High for anime illustration source rediscovery when source/post ID is absent.
provider_research.auth_api_key: Must be re-verified against current official docs before implementation.
provider_research.rate_limit: Provider-specific; first pilot should be sequential and conservative.
provider_research.privacy_risk: High because useful local no-source queries require visual-content upload; derived image only with explicit approval.

provider_research.auth_api_key: No stable official automation API identified for this workflow.
provider_research.privacy_risk: High if image upload is required.

provider_research.source_entity_usefulness: Useful for anime screenshot/scene lookup, not primary illustration source discovery.
provider_research.auth_api_key: Public API docs exist; current policy/rate limits must be re-verified.
provider_research.privacy_risk: Requires image URL or bytes for local no-source media.

provider_research.source_entity_usefulness: Strong after source/post ID is known; not enough for first no-source step.
provider_research.privacy_risk: Low for public post ID lookup, but current library lacks post IDs.

provider_research.source_entity_usefulness: High when a source URL/artwork ID is known.
provider_research.privacy_risk: High if credentials, scraping, private API, or image upload are involved.

provider_research.source_entity_usefulness: Work metadata enrichment after source/work is known; not reverse image search.
provider_research.auth_api_key: Public GraphQL API for basic public queries.
provider_research.rate_limit: Official rate limiting and 429 handling must be respected.
provider_research.privacy_risk: Low for public work IDs/names; do not send local metadata.

provider_research.source_entity_usefulness: Supplementary local recall, not source truth.

privacy_eligibility_policy.anime: Eligible only under explicit approved provider pilot; small sample; original upload blocked by default; derived input requires explicit approval.
privacy_eligibility_policy.unknown: Blocked by default until manual classification and explicit approval.
privacy_eligibility_policy.illustration: Blocked by default unless explicitly included under reviewed anime/illustration policy.
privacy_eligibility_policy.local_paths_filenames_source_labels_iclo: Never sent and never included in public reports.

recommended_phase_4_4_b_provider_categor: one SauceNAO-style reverse image search provider for anime illustration source discovery, contingent on official policy verification and explicit derived-image input approval

allowed: ExternalSource policy row disabled by default
MediaEntityCandidate suggested external candidates only if confidence policy allows
forbidden: automatic trusted Entity truth without review

phase_3_9_dependency_boundary.small_pilot_limit: 25 anime-only items, one provider, explicit input approval, cache-first, evidence/candidate-only, no assignments

manual_seed_and_local_retrieval_role.manual_seeds: useful for validation and conflict examples, not primary full coverage
manual_seed_and_local_retrieval_role.local_retrieval_or_clustering: supplementary recall only; no automatic confirmed assignment; global similarity graph deferred
